now_the_spec_says: Standing order, always: (1) fix or extend Claude — the whole mind-layer, (2) fix skills and the workflow, (3) fix what supports them (gates, inspectors, etc.), (4) build out the rest in line for librarian. The starting place now: build out /idea and /design — tier 2.
context: A standing ORDER doctrine, not a one-shot: when work competes, the mind's own layer comes first, then the skills/workflow it fires, then the gates and inspectors that support those, then everything queued toward librarian. THE BOUND OF TIER 1, ruled 2026-08-07 on CC's clarifying question and renamed by Akien to 'fix or extend claude': settings; CLAUDE.md; cleaning memory files; superclaude, rescueclaude, and any future specialized launchers; evaluating new skills from the web; the shim; running tests to compare model behavior; and making it possible to inject compact commands or otherwise change how the system or Akien interacts with CC. The tier includes capabilities NOT YET BUILT (compact injection is one) — tier 1 is extension, not only repair. The immediate application is the conformers: /idea and /design (built 2026-08-04, tier 2) are the starting place and read UNTOUCHED until their build-out lands.
